## Use DejaVu Sans Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set DejaVu Sans Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the DejaVu Sans Mono coding font

An open-source font with wide Unicode support. DejaVu Sans Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

DejaVu Sans Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## DejaVu Sans Mono FAQ

### Is DejaVu Sans Mono free?

Yes. DejaVu Sans Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does DejaVu Sans Mono support ligatures?

No. DejaVu Sans Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get DejaVu Sans Mono?

DejaVu Sans Mono is available from Official Download and Font Squirrel. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
